name: Staff of the Lost

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight. summary: +1 to this weapon’s attack and damage rolls.
text: +1 to this weapon’s attack and damage rolls. Reference-only: three nonrenewable charges cast Maze (DC 18) or Teleport for 1 each; at zero it becomes a mundane Quarterstaff. Curse prevents willingly discarding it, prevents knowing north, and imposes Disadvantage on navigation Survival checks. Each charge use summons 1d4 hostile Minotaurs of Baphomet within 30 feet on a d20 result of 1.
